highlights_headline: Upcoming servicing fixes harden mask-filtered glyph images against changes between font-scaler loads.
highlights_body: The native corrections retain Skia m158, existing package versions and the managed API.

bullets.lead: Filtered glyphs respect regenerated formats and buffer layout
bullets.detail: Rendering follows the reloaded glyph's path rather than stale properties. Incompatible and sub-byte masks are cleared instead of copied, and clipped embossed masks use full plane strides, preventing buffer overwrites, format assertions and corrupted or uncleared mask planes.
